name: Skywall
summary: Within the Elemental Plane, Al'Akir rules Skywall and its air elementals. The titans banished them there long ago, to a realm of wind, cloud, and lightning.

sections.title: A Prison in the Heavens
sections.body: The titans made the Elemental Plane a prison for Azeroth's unruly elemental spirits. After overthrowing the Old Gods, they sealed the spirits away from the surface world. The elemental lords fought among themselves and carved out separate dominions. Al'Akir the Windlord rules Skywall, where tempests still swirl in isolation.

sections.title: The War of Elements
sections.body: Old feuds followed the elemental lords into exile. Skywall has long fought over its borders with nearby realms, including the Firelands. During the Elemental Sundering, Garr and Baron Geddon, chief lieutenants of Ragnaros the Firelord, ambushed and betrayed Prince Thunderaan the Windseeker. Ragnaros devoured the prince's essence and bound its fragments in a shattered talisman.

sections.title: Isles of the Mist
sections.body: Beyond gales and djinn citadels, Zephras Isle drifts among Skywall's cloudbanks. The isle is a sanctuary inhabited by the Shen'dorei. Mortals on Azeroth rarely pierce the veil into the air realm. Across history, reckless spellcasters and weapon-crafters have risked disaster to siphon the Windlord's living storms.

faq.answer: Within the Elemental Plane, Skywall is the air elementals' dominion. The titans made that prison for the servants of the Old Gods, and its skies hold storms, clouds, and lightning.
Al'Akir the Windlord rules Skywall as the supreme Elemental Lord of air. Djinn, cyclones, and living storms fall within his dominion.
After defeating the Old Gods, the titans fashioned the Elemental Plane to imprison the chaotic elementals. The air elementals claimed a vast territory there, which became Skywall.

During the Elemental Sundering, Garr and Baron Geddon, Ragnaros the Firelord's lieutenants, ambushed Prince Thunderaan. Ragnaros consumed the air prince's essence and bound its remains in a shattered talisman of elemental binding.
Air elementals, powerful djinn lords, lightning revenants, and elemental storm drakes live in Skywall. The Shen'dorei dwell in a sanctuary on Zephras Isle.

Skywall lies within a separate dimensional prison, and mortals rarely reach it. Powerful sorcerers have manipulated elemental rifts to enter, while others have sought the isolated Shen'dorei on Zephras Isle.

angles.text: As a shaman, you revere Skywall's raw winds and lightning, and beseech them when you commune with the spirits of air.
As a mage, you follow the long history of arcanists seeking Skywall's boundless atmospheric power. Attempts to siphon Al'Akir's tempests often end in ruin.
